title: Classic Art Instruction: The Crowd-sourced List
content: A week or two ago, I shared a list ofmy favoriteclassic art instruction booksfrom Dover Publishing.In the comments, I invited you to suggest the classic art instruction books (more than 50 years old) that you thought were particularly helpful.Here's the list you suggested below. The links take you to Amazon pages where you can read more about each title.On the left is a poll. Please vote for your favorite books. You can vote for more than one.An Atlas of Animal Anatomy for Artists by W. Ellenberger et al.Animation by Preston BlairAtlas of Human Anatomy for the Artist by PeckBridgman’s Life Drawing by George BridgmanCarlson’s Guide to Landscape Painting by John F.
